scope: Read-only expansion/query when at least one juxtaposed endpoint operand is a statically elaborated ValueBundle.

openQuestionRecovered: a{} means all existing outgoing links from a
{}b means all existing incoming links to b
{}{} means all existing links in the selected memory view

models.reason: Ordinary set product makes a{} and {}b empty, so it cannot express the explicitly preserved all-outgoing/all-incoming query intent.

In expansion position only, an empty ValueBundle means an unconstrained endpoint domain. Non-empty bundles remain extensional sets of resolved endpoint identities. The result is the set of already existing Link identities satisfying the endpoint constraints.
Creating missing links during interpretation violates interpret != realize and would turn a query notation into an implicit mutation.
Returning hypothetical LinkForm values rather than existing L1 Link identities changes the result domain and is not required for the historical query/expansion intent.

input.left: resolved Form identity or flat resolved ValueBundle
input.right: resolved Form identity or flat resolved ValueBundle
input.precondition: at least one side is a statically elaborated ValueBundle

endpointDomains.nonEmptyValueBundle: its extensional set of resolved identities

preferredCandidate.result: flat extensional ValueBundle of existing Link identities

query.bothConstrained: intersection/filter by exact ordered endpoint pairs
query.bothWildcard: all links in the selected immutable/read-only memory view

preferredCandidate.ordering: semantic result order-insensitive; deterministic sorted LinkRef order may be used only for presentation/conformance
preferredCandidate.provenance: query constraints and source occurrence paths remain observable separately from the extensional result set
preferredCandidate.emptyBundleContextualNote: {} is the empty ValueBundle under value algebra. The expansion operator gives that empty endpoint operand a wildcard query role only because its parent operation is statically known to be bundle expansion; this is not runtime role guessing.

memoryFixture.note: The four links 0..3 form a closed finite graph. Symbol e resolves to existing LinkRef 2, but pair (0,2) is absent, enabling a missing-pair no-realize veto.

passMeaning: The historical bundle expansion/all-outgoing/all-incoming intent can be modeled as a statically selected read-only L4 query over existing links, without implicit materialization. Passing does not accept this semantics or modify mts-contract/v0.2.
